title: Laundry & Mudroom
note: Laundry and mudroom pack (tools/make_laundry_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

style.label: Style
style.note: Classic (turned legs, rolled arms, mouldings, brass) or modern (clean lines, slim tapered legs, black metal).

color.label: Colour
color.note: The colour of the bedding and upholstery or of the wood: burgundy, forest, navy, camel, charcoal, stone, teal, mustard, mahogany, walnut, cherry, oak, birch, white or black.

power_draw_w.label: Power draw (W)
power_draw_w.note: Watts drawn while it runs; 0 for anything that uses no electricity.

laundry_kind.label: Piece
laundry_kind.note: Which piece: boot_bench, coat_rack_wall, locker_unit, shoe_rack, laundry_wall_cabinet, folding_counter, laundry_sink, drying_rack, shelf_unit, ironing_board, laundry_basket or sorter_hamper.

water_per_use_l.label: Water per use (L)
water_per_use_l.note: Litres one use takes (the utility sink).

water_usage_lpm.label: Water flow (L/min)
water_usage_lpm.note: Litres per minute while running; 0 for a dry piece.
